name: Vulnify
description: Hosted Vulnify MCP server at https://mcp.vulnify.io/mcp. An agent describes an action (agent, action, resource, destination, record count) and gets ALLOW, REVIEW or BLOCK with a risk score and reasons. decide_action and check_mcp_tool_call record a decision in the caller's Vulnify organization; the other tools only read or dry-run. Off until you turn it on.
saferAlternatives: Use check_action or test_policies for a dry run: they skip the PII scan, record nothing, and a REVIEW from those tools does not open a human review. plan_policy_changes always runs with dryRun true and has no apply path. Call decide_action or check_mcp_tool_call to record a decision that can wait for a person.
A recorded REVIEW result waits for a person in the Vulnify app or Slack; this server cannot approve or deny one. Treat tool errors as not allowed, never as ALLOW.
